svg.title: pinright check
svg.desc: pinright check for lodash 4.17.20: a security notice with 5 advisories (2 high, 3 moderate) and the recommendation to move to 4.18.1 on the same 4.x line.

text.tspan: SECURITY NOTICE: lodash (npm)@4.17.20 has 5 known advisories.

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
text.tspan: - GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm (CVE-2021-23337) [HIGH]: Command Injection in lodash fixed in 4.17.21

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
text.tspan: - GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc (CVE-2026-4800) [HIGH]: lodash vulnerable to Code Injection via `_.template` imports

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
text.tspan: - GHSA-29mw-wpgm-hmr9 (CVE-2020-28500) [MODERATE]: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in lodash

text.font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
'Cascadia Mono', 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
text.tspan: - GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh (CVE-2026-2950) [MODERATE]: lodash vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via array path

text.tspan: - GHSA-xxjr-mmjv-4gpg (CVE-2025-13465) [MODERATE]: Lodash has Prototype Pollution Vulnerability in `_.unset`

text.tspan: Recommended within 4.x: 4.18.1 (same release line, no API break expected). Upgrade: npm install lodash@4.18.1
